cannot_determine: whether a real operator is behind this, or whether it is entirely fabricated - a fictional card and a practitioner's note rendered by the same generator are identical on the page
whether any number in it was measured
whether the author has the experience the card implies
usable_as: REFERENCE - a floor to reason from. Never as evidence about this grow. A measured outcome here outranks it, and the divergence is the finding.
